[{"path": "routekit/cli.py", "sha256": "b7e22987f129bb82feda05a294a577f82c2eaf9c870b5a859a742e6ec106924d", "text": """"Command-line entry point for warehouse manifests."""
import argparse
import json
from routekit.manifest import build_manifest


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="routekit")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    manifest = commands.add_parser("manifest")
    manifest.add_argument("zone")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    print(json.dumps(build_manifest(args.zone), sort_keys=True))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
